Dans un milieu favorable, elle reste presque introuvable.

Pour en tirer ses propriétés, elle se porte sur soi.

This flower is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known in north-western Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains almost impossible to find.

To obtain its properties, it is worn or carried.

Among the Cardolani, wearing this flower is considered a sign of good fortune. While it remains fresh, it is believed to strengthen morale and protect its wearer.
